name: Tea Fancies
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
These tiny edible treats not only delight the taste buds, but alter the body in strange and magnificent ways. Upon eating the fancies, you transform into a well-dressed Tiny animal for 10 minutes with the effects of Pest Form, except you can talk while in this form and can't Dismiss the effect. To determine what kind of animal you're transformed into, roll 1d6;
- A cat wearing a tuxedo and a top hat

- A dodo bird with a very large blue ribbon

- A hedgehog with tiny red boots and white gloves

- A dog wearing a deerstalker hat and an ulster coat

- A frog wearing a powdered white wig and a matching white jabot

- A goose wearing a wide-brimmed sun hat adorned with many flowers.
